description: This file implements methods for the AWCContainerBase class, providing system information such as memory, processor, and network interfaces, with internal structures for memory and processor info.

classes.name: AWCMemoryInfo
classes.description: A class representing memory information, implementing IMemoryInfo interface.

classes.name: AWCProcessorInfo
classes.description: A class representing processor information, implementing IProcessorInfo interface.

methods.name: AWCContainerBase::Memory
methods.description: Returns a new AWCMemoryInfo object containing memory info.

methods.name: AWCContainerBase::ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns a new AWCProcessorInfo object containing processor info.

methods.name: AWCContainerBase::NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns nullptr, indicating no network interfaces are available or implemented.
